whenToUse: You compare the same items by several measures, such as sales by branch.
People need to sort to see rankings.
whenNotToUse: There are only one or two columns (use a list).
Many columns on small screens (switch to a card list).
Tables used for layout (use CSS grid).

alternatives.name: Selectable Table
alternatives.reason: Choosing and acting on several rows.

accessibility: Use a real table, caption, and th scope so each cell is read with its header.
Sort buttons sit inside the headers, and the sorted column announces its direction with aria-sort.
The first cell of each row is th scope="row", which becomes the row's name.
Numbers use tabular-nums so the digits line up.
